title: Trap the remaining reachable terminating signals so the lock is never freed under a live writer
summary: Authorized single bounded cycle: fix the confirmed F6-R11 blocker - SIGHUP is untrapped and bash runs the EXIT trap immediately on an untrapped fatal signal, so a pid-only HUP frees the operation lock mid-write and a second update can acquire alongside the pending writer. Apply the reviewer-verified remedy (trap HUP into the established disarm-and-exit handler, rc 129), decide USR1/USR2/ALRM/PIPE explicitly per the measured signal matrix, deliberately do not trap QUIT (availability regression), correct the two contract sentences the R10 fix made false, and add a pid-only SIGHUP regression in the existing section-11 style with anti-vacuity proven against the R10-fixed-but-HUP-untrapped baseline. Register the five out-of-scope findings in the hardening backlog without fixing them. Surface is bin/agent-flow-kit, the contract document, the mutation test suite, and story records only; any need to touch lib is an explicit stop condition. Run all Story 1.2 gates including loaded mutation runs and git diff --check.
